_comment: Shipped preset for Hunyuan3D 2.1 image-to-mesh, adapted from ComfyUI's official 3d_hunyuan3d-v2.1 template (flattened, MarkdownNote dropped, KSampler seed randomized per Run). Chain: LoadImage #2 -> CLIPVisionEncode #13 -> Hunyuan3Dv2Conditioning #6 -> KSampler #7 -> VAEDecodeHunyuan3D #8 -> VoxelToMesh #9 -> SaveGLB #10. Sampler/decoder defaults match the official template (30 steps / cfg 5 / euler-normal, latent resolution 4096, num_chunks 8000, octree_resolution 256, surface-net threshold 0.6); quality knobs are overridable via stage custom params (seed / steps / guidance).
label: Hunyuan3D 2.1
description: Hunyuan3D 2.1 image-to-3D. Takes one upstream image, outputs an untextured mesh GLB. Requires hunyuan_3d_v2.1.safetensors in models/checkpoints — see workflows/model/README.md. Optional custom params: seed, steps (30), guidance (5).

image.error: Hunyuan3D 2.1 needs an upstream image — wire one into this stage's images slot.
